pairs.target: lín zhào zài pénglǐ xiē dào rìtou yí guò shídèng , cái shùnzhe héàn wǎnghuí zǒu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao rested in the shelter until the sun moved past the bench, then walked back along the riverbank.
pairs.hanzi: 林照在棚里歇到日头移过石凳，才顺着河岸往回走。

pairs.target: tā bù wǎng yóu pù nàbiān qù , cóng xièhuò de pōdào rào shànglái , zhǎodào le bùtóu nà jiān gěi jiǎofū huànyào de xiǎowū .
pairs.english: She didn't head toward the oil shops. She came up by the unloading ramp and found the little room at the landing where porters had their dressings changed.
pairs.hanzi: 她不往油铺那边去，从卸货的坡道绕上来，找到了埠头那间给脚夫换药的小屋。

pairs.target: wūlǐ yǒu gǔ shībù zhǔ guò de qìwèi .
pairs.english: The room smelled of damp cloth that had been boiled.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里有股湿布煮过的气味。

pairs.target: zuòzài chuāng xià de fùrén jiào tā bǎ yījīn sōngkāi , jiē le jiù bù , wèn tā zhè jǐrì shāo guò méiyǒu .
pairs.english: The woman by the window told her to loosen her lapel, lifted the old cloth and asked whether she had a fever in the last few days.
pairs.hanzi: 坐在窗下的妇人叫她把衣襟松开，揭了旧布，问她这几日烧过没有。

pairs.target: " qiánjǐrì shāo guò .
pairs.english: “I had a fever a few days ago.
pairs.hanzi: “前几日烧过。

pairs.target: jīn zǎo méiyǒu . "
pairs.english: None this morning.”
pairs.hanzi: 今早没有。”

pairs.target: fùrén qiáo le tā yìyǎn , méi zài wèn shāng shì zěnme lái de .
pairs.english: The woman glanced at her and did not go on to ask how she had got hurt.
pairs.hanzi: 妇人瞧了她一眼，没再问伤是怎么来的。

pairs.target: děng xīn bù chánshàngqù , lín zhào fú zhe zhuō jiǎo zhàn qǐlái , shìleshì zhí yāo ,
pairs.english: Once the fresh cloth was wrapped around her, Lin Zhao held the table corner to stand and tried straightening up.
pairs.hanzi: 等新布缠上去，林照扶着桌角站起来，试了试直腰，

pairs.target: téng háishì téng , yīshang lǐ què búzài tiēzhe nà piàn shī nián de dōngxī .
pairs.english: It still hurt, but the damp, sticky cloth no longer clung inside her clothes.
pairs.hanzi: 疼还是疼，衣裳里却不再贴着那片湿黏的东西。

pairs.target: " zǒuyuǎnlù ? "
pairs.english: “Going far?”
pairs.hanzi: “走远路？”

pairs.target: fùrén kànjiàn tā bǎ shuǐnáng guà qǐlái .
pairs.english: The woman saw her hang up the waterskin.
pairs.hanzi: 妇人看见她把水囊挂起来。

pairs.target: " hái bù zhīdào . "
pairs.english: “I don't know yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “还不知道。”

pairs.target: " nà jiù děng zhīdào le , zài suàn nǐ néng zǒu duō yuǎn . "
pairs.english: “Wait till you know, then see how far you can go.”
pairs.hanzi: “那就等知道了，再算你能走多远。”

pairs.target: fùrén duān qǐ pén ,
pairs.english: The woman picked up the basin.
pairs.hanzi: 妇人端起盆，

pairs.target: " bù qián xià huílái gěi . "
pairs.english: “Pay for the cloth next time you come.”
pairs.hanzi: “布钱下回来给。”

pairs.target: lín zhào xiǎng shuō zìjǐ wèibì hái lái ,
pairs.english: Lin Zhao wanted to say she might never come back.
pairs.hanzi: 林照想说自己未必还来，

pairs.target: huà dào le zuǐbiān , zhǐ shuō le shēng xiè .
pairs.english: The words reached her lips, but all she said was thanks.
pairs.hanzi: 话到了嘴边，只说了声谢。

pairs.target: tā zài ménwài bǎ shuǐnáng guànmǎn , yánzhe qiáng mànmàn zǒu , tīngjiàn qiántou yǒurén zài shǔ huò .
pairs.english: She filled the waterskin outside the door and walked slowly along the wall until she heard someone ahead counting the load.
pairs.hanzi: 她在门外把水囊灌满，沿着墙慢慢走，听见前头有人在数货。

pairs.target: " shíqī .
pairs.english: “Seventeen.
pairs.hanzi: “十七。

pairs.target: shíqī .
pairs.english: Seventeen.
pairs.hanzi: 十七。

pairs.target: zěnme yòu shì shíqī ? "
pairs.english: Why is it seventeen again?”
pairs.hanzi: 怎么又是十七？”

pairs.target: yígè dài huī mào de nánrén zhàn zài chēwěi , shǒulǐ de dānzi yǐjīng niē zhòu le .
pairs.english: A man in a gray cap stood at the back of the cart. The list in his hand was already crumpled.
pairs.hanzi: 一个戴灰帽的男人站在车尾，手里的单子已经捏皱了。

pairs.target: chē biān yǒu gè huǒjì , zhèng bǎ yìkǔn ruǎn lǒu wǎng chēshàng tuī , tīngjiàn zhèhuà biàn sōng le shǒu .
pairs.english: A worker beside the cart was pushing a bundle of pliable baskets aboard, and let go at those words.
pairs.hanzi: 车边有个伙计，正把一捆软篓往车上推，听见这话便松了手。

pairs.target: " wǒ shǔ de yě shì shíqī . "
pairs.english: “I counted seventeen too.”
pairs.hanzi: “我数的也是十七。”

pairs.target: lín zhàozhàn zài qiángbiān , kàn le liǎngyǎn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao stood by the wall and looked the load over.
pairs.hanzi: 林照站在墙边，看了两眼。

pairs.target: zuì dǐxià nà kǔn yòng de shì jiù shéng , shéng tóu cóng lǒu kǒu chuān guòqù , yòu cóng lìngyìzhī lǒu dǐ dōu huílái .
pairs.english: The bottom bundle used old cord. Its end passed through the mouth of one basket and looped back under the base of another basket.
pairs.hanzi: 最底下那捆用的是旧绳，绳头从篓口穿过去，又从另一只篓底兜回来。

pairs.target: tā jiàn guò zhèyàng bǎng de , kōng lǒu tào zhe shěng dìfāng , xièhuò shí cái chāikāi .
pairs.english: She'd seen bundles tied that way. Empty baskets nested to save space and were only separated at unloading.
pairs.hanzi: 她见过这样绑的，空篓套着省地方，卸货时才拆开。

pairs.target: " nà kǔn shì liǎngzhī . "
pairs.english: “That bundle is two baskets,”
pairs.hanzi: “那捆是两只。”

pairs.target: tā shuō .
pairs.english: she said.
pairs.hanzi: 她说。

pairs.target: huī mào nánrén zhuǎnguò liǎn .
pairs.english: The man in the gray cap turned his face toward her.
pairs.hanzi: 灰帽男人转过脸。

pairs.target: huǒjì bǎ nà kǔn wǎng wài tuō le tuō , lùchū tào zài lǐtou de lìng yídào lǒu yán .
pairs.english: The worker dragged the bundle outward a little, exposing the rim of the other basket nested inside.
pairs.hanzi: 伙计把那捆往外拖了拖，露出套在里头的另一道篓沿。

pairs.target: " dānzi shàng xiě de shì zhī . "
pairs.english: “The list counts by the basket,”
pairs.hanzi: “单子上写的是只。”

pairs.target: lín zhàoshuō .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao said.
pairs.hanzi: 林照说。

pairs.target: nánrén dītóu qù kàn .
pairs.english: The man looked down at it.
pairs.hanzi: 男人低头去看。

pairs.target: gé le yíhuìer , tā bǎ dānzi chēn píng , ná zhǐjiǎ zài shíbā pángbiān qiā le gè yìn .
pairs.english: After a moment he smoothed out the list and used his fingernail to press a mark beside eighteen.
pairs.hanzi: 隔了一会儿，他把单子抻平，拿指甲在十八旁边掐了个印。

pairs.target: " zuò guò zhè háng ? "
pairs.english: “Worked in this trade?”
pairs.hanzi: “做过这行？”

pairs.target: " bèi guò huò , yě rèn dānzi . "
pairs.english: “I've carried freight, and I can read a list.”
pairs.hanzi: “背过货，也认单子。”

pairs.target: tā cháo chē qián kàn le yìyǎn ,
pairs.english: She glanced toward the front of the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 她朝车前看了一眼，

pairs.target: " nǐmen zhè shì wǎng nǎér qù ? "
pairs.english: “Where are you headed?”
pairs.hanzi: “你们这是往哪儿去？”

pairs.target: " běibiān .
pairs.english: “North.
pairs.hanzi: “北边。

pairs.target: míngzǎo chū chéng , xiān dào liǔ qiáo yì . "
pairs.english: We leave town tomorrow morning and first go to Willow Bridge Station.”
pairs.hanzi: 明早出城，先到柳桥驿。”

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu tīng guò zhège yì míng , zhǐ zhīdào zhè yílù líjiā yuèláiyuè yuǎn .
pairs.english: She'd never heard the station's name. All she knew was that the road would take her farther and farther from home.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有听过这个驿名，只知道这一路离家越来越远。

pairs.target: chē bǎn shàng hái kōng zhe yì jié , gòu yígè rén zuò .
pairs.english: There was still a stretch of cart bed free, enough for one person to sit.
pairs.hanzi: 车板上还空着一截，够一个人坐。

pairs.target: tā kànzhe nà jié chē bǎn , shuō zìjǐ xiǎng gēn yìchéng .
pairs.english: Looking at that stretch of cart bed, she said she wanted to come along for part of the way.
pairs.hanzi: 她看着那截车板，说自己想跟一程。

pairs.target: " chēshàng quē de shì tái huò de rén . "
pairs.english: “We need someone who can lift freight.”
pairs.hanzi: “车上缺的是抬货的人。”

pairs.target: nánrén de yǎnjīng luòdào tā fú qiáng de shǒushàng .
pairs.english: The man's eyes settled on her hand against the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 男人的眼睛落到她扶墙的手上。

pairs.target: lín zhào bǎshǒu shōuhuí lái , jiǎobèi lìkè tiào le yíxià .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao drew her hand back, and pain shot through her instep at once.
pairs.hanzi: 林照把手收回来，脚背立刻跳了一下。

pairs.target: tā méi shuō zìjǐ tái dé dòng .
pairs.english: She didn't say she could lift it.
pairs.hanzi: 她没说自己抬得动。

pairs.target: " nǐ yàoshi hái dé shǔyíbiàn , wǒ néng tì nǐ zhào dān chá .
pairs.english: “If you still need another count, I can check it against the list for you.
pairs.hanzi: “你要是还得数一遍，我能替你照单查。

pairs.target: dào le yìzhàn , shuí xiè nǎ jiàn , wǒ yě néng jì . "
pairs.english: At the station I can also record who unloads each item.”
pairs.hanzi: 到了驿站，谁卸哪件，我也能记。”

pairs.target: nánrén méi lìkè jiē huà .
pairs.english: The man didn't answer immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 男人没立刻接话。

pairs.target: tā jiāng dānzi dìguòlái , cháo chēshàng piān le piāntóu .
pairs.english: He held out the list and tipped his head toward the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 他将单子递过来，朝车上偏了偏头。

pairs.target: " xiān bǎ zhè chē cháwán .
pairs.english: “Finish checking this cart first.
pairs.hanzi: “先把这车查完。

pairs.target: biébān , nǎyàng kànbújiàn jiù jiào tā fān gěi nǐ kàn . "
pairs.english: Don't lift anything. If you can't see something, ask him to turn it over for you.”
pairs.hanzi: 别搬，哪样看不见就叫他翻给你看。”

pairs.target: zhǐ shàng yǒu jǐchù mò gěishuǐ yīn kāi le , shíbā dǎo huán qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: Water had made the ink run in several places on the paper, but eighteen was still clear.
pairs.hanzi: 纸上有几处墨给水洇开了，十八倒还清楚。

pairs.target: lín zhào bǎ dānzi pù zài chēyán , zhǎodào tóu yíxiàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao spread the list on the cart's edge and found the first entry.
pairs.hanzi: 林照把单子铺在车沿，找到头一项。

pairs.target: tā gāng yào cóng zuǒbiān shǔqǐ , yòu tíngxiàlái , qǐng huǒjì xiān bǎ yǐjīng chá guò de nà kǔn nuó dào yìpáng .
pairs.english: She was about to start counting from the left when she stopped and asked the worker to move the bundle already checked to one side first.
pairs.hanzi: 她刚要从左边数起，又停下来，请伙计先把已经查过的那捆挪到一旁。

pairs.target: zhè yìhuí , tā zhīdào nǎ yíyàng suàn guò le .
pairs.english: This time she knew which item she'd already counted.
pairs.hanzi: 这一回，她知道哪一样算过了。
